roleInfo.name: Player
roleInfo.description: You hate taking points, and you always play to win 😎

Default.inAMomentChoose: ($1) - in a moment, choose which players would like Ludio to teach them how to play this game!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.beTheFirstPlayer: Be the first player to get 4 Humans safely onto your beach to win — while dodging the Sharks lurking in the deck!
Default.whenTheDeckReaches: When the deck reaches you, either Flip its top card onto your own beach, or Pass the deck to the next player. Flipping is how you collect Humans — but the card might be a Shark!
Default.ifASharkLands: If a Shark lands on your beach, it scares off every Human you've collected — your beach is wiped clean!
Default.aHumanChasesAway: A Human chases away 1 Shark already on your beach. And if 3 Sharks ever pile up together, they all get cleared away too.
Default.get4HumansOnto: Get 4 Humans onto your beach at once and the game is yours. Good luck — and stay out of the water! 🦈
Default.thereAreCardsIn: There are ($1) cards in the game
Default.ofThemAreSharks: ($1) of them are Sharks and ($2) of them are Humans!
Default.willYouFlipA: ($1), will you flip a card or pass on the deck to the next player?
Default.willYouFlipA2: ($1), will you flip a card or end your turn?
Default.congratsOnOpeningA: Congrats on opening a shark-free beach!
